deriver.isa-x86-sha.label: x86-64 · SHA extensions (SHA-NI)
deriver.isa-x86-sha.registers.label: x86-64 · SHA-NI · XMM registers
deriver.isa-x86-sha.note.rnds2: Two rounds in one instruction. The destination holds C, D, G, H and receives A, B, E, F; the source holds A, B, E, F (A in the highest dword). K+W of both rounds comes from the low half of the implicit xmm0.
deriver.isa-x86-sha.note.nextWk: Moves K+W of rounds {{first}}, {{last}} into the low half of xmm0 for the next sha256rnds2.
deriver.isa-x86-sha.note.scheduleAhead: The message schedule runs ahead: this instruction works on W{{first}}…W{{last}} several rounds before the state view's schedule steps write them. The four message registers hold a sliding window of 16 schedule words.
deriver.isa-x86-sha.note.earlySave: The compiler moved this copy of the initial A, B, E, F, kept for the feed-forward, between the rounds.
